transcript.message: Thanks for calling Riverbend Physical Therapy, this is Maya on the new-patient line. If this is a medical emergency, please hang up and call 911. How can I help you today?
Hi, yeah - I'm trying to get a refill on my muscle relaxer, my doctor's out of town and I was told to call here.

I'm sorry, but I can't help with prescription refills, since we're a physical therapy clinic and only book new patient evaluations. Your doctor's office or pharmacy would be the best place to reach out about the refill. Before we go further, could I get the best callback number for you, starting with the area code?
Uh, wait - physical therapy? I think I was given the wrong number then. So you can't help me at all?

I'm sorry, I can't help with refills here. Your pharmacist or your doctor's after-hours line can usually help with a muscle relaxer refill while the doctor is away. If you're looking for a physical therapy evaluation, I can help with that. What's the best callback number for you?
Yeah no, I don't need PT. I'll try my doctor's after-hours line. Thanks anyway.
